description: Ministry of Education - Bachelor of Science Honours in Data Science, Horizon College of Business and Technology (Pvt.) Ltd. - Bachelor of Education Honours in Sports and Physical Education, CINEC Campus (Pvt.) Ltd.
categorisation: This gazette content pertains to educational matters, specifically the recognition and regulation of degree programs at private higher education institutions (Horizon College of Business & Technology and CINEC Campus). It involves setting conditions and entry qualifications for specific degree programs under the Universities Act. While it mentions the Minister of Education by name, it does not involve government structural changes, personnel appointments, or detailed portfolio responsibilities. The content focuses on academic regulations and institutional accreditation, which falls under the Miscellaneous category (Type 10) for educational matters not covered by other specialized types.
